en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a small rural railway station with a single electrified track curving into the distance. On the left is a modest station building with large windows and a canopy over the platform. On the right are a few two‑story houses or shops and open countryside with forest in the background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.
